description: Hierarchically cluster a genes x samples expression matrix (UPGMA/average, complete, or single linkage; Euclidean or correlation distance) and return the row/column leaf order, dendrogram merge trees, and row-z-scored values for the Clustered Expression Heatmap visualization.

distanceMetric.description: correlation = 1 - Pearson r (the standard expression-heatmap default); euclidean = straight-line distance.

linkage.description: average = UPGMA (standard default), complete = farthest-neighbor, single = nearest-neighbor.

values.description: genes x samples numeric matrix — one row per gene, in the same order as `genes`.

zScoreRows.description: Row-wise z-score each gene's values before clustering and returning (the conventional 'relative expression' heatmap normalization — the dendrograms are computed on the same scaled matrix the heatmap shows, as in seaborn's clustermap(z_score=0) / pheatmap's scale="row").

name: expression_heatmap_cluster
title: Expression heatmap clustering
